findings.text: follow-on: the assertion that the refused blocker's stored status != "cleared" passes for any status the code might write other than cleared; comparing against "held" would name the state the refusal must preserve.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 39ed4f2d8; the fix moves the cleared-status return above the probe lookup in reckon/project_state.py and tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py adds the withdrawn-probe and unknown-probe cases (3 files, +91/-4).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a cleared blocker reporting its clear and an unknown-probe refusal, both covered by a test; tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py:148 exercises the first after monkeypatch.delitem at :181 and the second at :202 against a tmp_path docs tree.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a cleared blocker reports its recorded clear whatever the registry now holds; reckon/project_state.py:1347 returns the recorded reason before the probe-id lookup at :1352, so a withdrawn probe no longer raises.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the new test red at base and green at head, the 20-file population at 308 base versus 309 head both EXIT=0 with zero added failures, and a negative control reddening the new test.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares reckon/project_state.py, tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-held-blocker-clears-on-its-probe/a-cleared-blocker-reports-its-clear.html; every path in the 39ed4f2d8..b2887726b diff lies inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py:182 reddens on the reverted order, because monkeypatch.delitem removes path-exists and the base lookup then raises unknown held blocker probe id.
justifications.evidence: the gate names tests/test_held_blocker_probe.py and its result is recorded at EXIT=0 in gate-head-new-test.log, with the red-at-base shown in negative-control-base.log and both populations in gate-base-population.log and gate-head-population.log.
justifications.fit: the moved lines keep the surrounding early-return idiom of reckon/project_state.py:1345 and introduce no new name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/project_state.py:1347-1351 returns the stored cleared reason before the probe-id membership check at :1352, which is what the section goal names.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the b2887726b diff is a declared write path and the change carries nothing the goal does not imply.
